purpose: Test the four strongest predeclared Phase 004 conditional hypotheses without changing strategy parameters or constructing a router.

design.source_replication_scope: Adjusted Alpaca IEX daily bars available from 2020-07-27 through 2026-09-25. This checks feed sensitivity but is not an independent market sample.
design.independence_rule: Only observations from sessions on or after the forward start count as statistically untouched time-sample evidence.
design.selection_rule: All hypotheses and directions were frozen from Phase 004 before Phase 005 data were evaluated.

interpretation_rule: Source replication can reject a fragile finding but cannot establish independent recurrence. Forward evidence remains descriptive until adequate sessions and episodes accumulate.
